domain_notes: ds^2 = -dt^2 + 2(1-k) dt dx + k(2-k) dx^2 + drho^2 + rho^2 dphi^2. The (t,x) block has determinant exactly -1 for every k, so the chart is Lorentzian everywhere. A single tube is not itself a time machine. The smooth step is a REGULATOR CHOICE, not part of an exact solution, so no causal boundary may be derived from this entry (defect D-06).
